diagnosis: The José V11 source-recovery lane was repeating an evidence-stable external-source boundary. G000003 exhaustively scanned reachable Git objects and historical export/archive with zero exact source candidates; G000006 later revalidated the only path history, current workstream inventory and LAB artifact and still found no newly surfaced authoritative source. Ordinary recovery had no new causal input, so another generation would spend capacity replaying the same search rather than changing the state.
intervention: Patched the existing José source-recovery job with recovery_policy.mode=fixed_generation at G000006 and attention_route=NEW_AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Ordinary recovery must now wait for a genuinely new durable source/provenance ref that can be checked against the immutable 69,235-byte/SHA-256 target. The source bytes, V11 pointers and acceptance gate were not changed.

tests.name: loop causal evidence
tests.detail: G000003 and G000006 independently end at NO authentic/new authoritative source after exhaustive and delta revalidation; no new source evidence exists between them.

tests.name: bounded recovery policy
tests.detail: José derived owner now fixes ordinary recovery at generation 6 and requires a new durable source/provenance ref before attention clears.

tests.name: authority and bytes preservation
tests.detail: No corrupt V11 material bytes, Current/Catalog/Lineage/Human Accepted/Served pointers or immutable target identity were changed.

remaining_boundary: Actual recovery still requires a genuinely external or newly surfaced authoritative V11 source proving decoded bytes=69235 and SHA-256=0cf9a40fb53e977dccb40c9755d668a3ee922ccd61883f19229bb4a113139a05.
